free_text: 67 y/o male, PSA 6.0, PI-RADS 4 lesion after prior negative biopsy. Repeat biopsy indicated due to PI-RADS 4 finding and rising PSA, despite prior negative result. Low PSA density of 0.08 suggests waiting is tolerable, but repeat sampling is warranted. Alternative plan is to wait one year for re-evaluation.
